decision_basis: CRP/OLR1 direct binding or receptor-dependence together with ROS/complement and endothelial or macrophage inflammatory outputs support qualified-high exact binding/function evidence; no canonical kinase relay is inferred.

GM-CSF/SDC2-CSF2RA co-receptor evidence with SDC2 phosphorylation, ERK1 signaling, and human osteoblast mitogenic output supports qualified-high co-receptor relay/function evidence; SDC2 is not treated as a standalone cytokine receptor.
